source: USDA FoodData Central SR Legacy (April 2018), per 100 g; computed by tools/build_plan_foods.py

recipes.name: Veggie Egg-White Omelette & Toast

ingredients.label: 5 egg whites (or ⅔ cup carton whites)
6 cherry tomatoes
ingredients.usda: Tomatoes, red, ripe, raw, year round average

steps: Sauté mushrooms and spinach in the oil for 3 min.
Pour in the whisked eggs and whites, cook until set and fold.
Serve with tomatoes and toast.
recipes.why: Mostly protein for few calories, with vegetables for volume — protein and fibre both help with fullness while dieting.

recipes.name: Greek Yogurt, Berries & Oats

ingredients.label: ¾ cup nonfat Greek yogurt
ingredients.usda: Yogurt, Greek, plain, nonfat (Includes foods for USDA's Food Distribution Program)

ingredients.label: ⅔ cup frozen blueberries
ingredients.usda: Blueberries, frozen, unsweetened (Includes foods for USDA's Food Distribution Program)

ingredients.label: ⅓ cup rolled oats
ingredients.usda: Cereals, oats, regular and quick, not fortified, dry

steps: Stir oats and chia into the yogurt (or leave overnight).
Top with thawed berries and cinnamon.
recipes.why: About 25 g protein and 8 g fibre — a high-protein, high-fibre start that is easy to scale.

recipes.name: Soy-Milk Berry Oats

ingredients.label: ½ cup rolled oats
ingredients.usda: Cereals, oats, regular and quick, not fortified, dry

ingredients.label: 1 cup soy milk
ingredients.usda: Soymilk, original and vanilla, with added calcium, vitamins A and D

ingredients.label: ½ cup blueberries
ingredients.usda: Blueberries, frozen, unsweetened (Includes foods for USDA's Food Distribution Program)

ingredients.label: 1 tbsp pumpkin seeds
ingredients.usda: Seeds, pumpkin and squash seed kernels, dried

steps: Simmer oats in soy milk 4–5 min (or microwave 2 min).
Top with berries, pumpkin seeds and cinnamon.
recipes.why: Plant protein from soy milk and seeds plus oat fibre.

recipes.name: Warm Quinoa Apple Bowl

ingredients.label: ½ apple, diced
ingredients.usda: Apples, raw, with skin (Includes foods for USDA's Food Distribution Program)

ingredients.label: 1 tbsp pumpkin seeds
ingredients.usda: Seeds, pumpkin and squash seed kernels, dried

steps: Warm the quinoa with a splash of water and the apple for 3 min.
Top with seeds, cinnamon and maple.
recipes.why: Free of gluten, dairy, eggs, soy and nuts — seeds supply protein and healthy fats.

recipes.name: Smoked Salmon Yogurt Toast

ingredients.label: ¼ cup Greek yogurt (as spread)
ingredients.usda: Yogurt, Greek, plain, nonfat (Includes foods for USDA's Food Distribution Program)

steps: Spread yogurt on the toast, add cucumber and salmon, finish with lemon and pepper.
recipes.why: Fish protein and omega-3 fats; smoked salmon is salty, so balance with lower-salt meals.

recipes.name: Eggs, Spinach & Avocado Plate

ingredients.label: 8 cherry tomatoes
ingredients.usda: Tomatoes, red, ripe, raw, year round average

steps: Wilt spinach in the oil, then scramble eggs and whites.
Serve with avocado and tomatoes.
recipes.why: A lower-carb breakfast: protein and fat with vegetables.

recipes.name: Tofu & Potato Breakfast Hash

ingredients.label: 180 g firm tofu
ingredients.usda: Tofu, raw, firm, prepared with calcium sulfate

ingredients.label: 1 small baked potato, diced
ingredients.usda: Potatoes, baked, flesh and skin, without salt

steps: Brown the diced potato in the oil 6–8 min.
Crumble in the tofu with the pepper, cook 5 min, fold in spinach. Season with turmeric, salt and pepper.
recipes.why: Gluten-free vegan protein and potato for training mornings.

recipes.name: Banana Oat Protein Pancakes

ingredients.label: ½ cup oats, blended
ingredients.usda: Cereals, oats, regular and quick, not fortified, dry

ingredients.label: ⅓ cup Greek yogurt (topping)
ingredients.usda: Yogurt, Greek, plain, nonfat (Includes foods for USDA's Food Distribution Program)

ingredients.label: ⅓ cup berries
ingredients.usda: Blueberries, frozen, unsweetened (Includes foods for USDA's Food Distribution Program)

steps: Blend oats, egg, whites and banana; rest 2 min.
Cook small pancakes 2 min per side in a non-stick pan.
Top with yogurt and berries.
recipes.why: Pancakes rebuilt around egg whites and yogurt for ~35 g protein.

recipes.name: Cottage Cheese, Pear & Seeds

ingredients.label: 2 tsp pumpkin seeds
ingredients.usda: Seeds, pumpkin and squash seed kernels, dried

steps: Top cottage cheese with pear, seeds and cinnamon.
recipes.why: Casein-rich and filling; no cooking and no gluten.

recipes.name: Turkey & Veggie Egg Muffins

ingredients.label: 2 oz cooked 93% lean ground turkey
ingredients.usda: Turkey, ground, 93% lean, 7% fat, pan-broiled crumbles

steps: Whisk eggs, stir in turkey, chopped spinach and pepper.
Pour into 4 muffin cups, top with cheese, bake 18–20 min at 180 °C / 350 °F. Keeps 4 days.
recipes.why: Batch-cooked protein for busy mornings.

recipes.name: Mediterranean Chicken Quinoa Bowl

ingredients.label: 120 g cooked chicken breast
ingredients.usda: Chicken, broilers or fryers, breast, meat only, cooked, roasted

ingredients.label: 8 cherry tomatoes
ingredients.usda: Tomatoes, red, ripe, raw, year round average

ingredients.label: ⅓ cup chickpeas
ingredients.usda: Chickpeas (garbanzo beans, bengal gram), mature seeds, canned, drained solids

steps: Cook quinoa; grill or roast the chicken.
Toss vegetables and chickpeas with oil and lemon, top with chicken and feta.
recipes.why: Olive oil, legumes, vegetables and whole grains — the core of a Mediterranean pattern, which performed well for weight loss in the DIRECT trial.

recipes.name: Turkey & Bean Chili

ingredients.label: 110 g 93% lean ground turkey (cooked)
ingredients.usda: Turkey, ground, 93% lean, 7% fat, pan-broiled crumbles

ingredients.label: ½ cup kidney beans
ingredients.usda: Beans, kidney, red, mature seeds, canned, drained solids

steps: Brown turkey with onion and pepper in the oil.
Add tomatoes, beans and chili spices; simmer 20 min. Freezes well.
recipes.why: High protein and high fibre in one pot — a cheap, filling batch meal.

recipes.name: Salmon, Potatoes & Green Beans

ingredients.label: 120 g salmon fillet
ingredients.usda: Fish, salmon, Atlantic, farmed, cooked, dry heat

ingredients.label: 1 medium potato
ingredients.usda: Potatoes, baked, flesh and skin, without salt

ingredients.label: 1 cup green beans
ingredients.usda: Beans, snap, green, cooked, boiled, drained, without salt

steps: Roast potato wedges 25 min at 220 °C / 425 °F.
Add salmon for the last 12 min; steam the beans.
Finish with oil and lemon.
recipes.why: Fish twice a week fits Mediterranean-style eating; potatoes are a filling carbohydrate.

recipes.name: Shrimp Veggie Stir-Fry

ingredients.label: ¾ cup cooked rice
ingredients.usda: Rice, white, long-grain, regular, enriched, cooked

ingredients.label: 1 cup stir-fry vegetables
ingredients.usda: Vegetables, mixed, frozen, cooked, boiled, drained, without salt

ingredients.label: 1 tbsp soy sauce
ingredients.usda: Soy sauce made from soy and wheat (shoyu)

steps: Stir-fry garlic and vegetables 4 min in the oil.
Add shrimp and soy sauce for 2 min, serve over rice.
recipes.why: Shrimp is very lean protein; vegetables add volume for few calories.

recipes.name: Lentil & Vegetable Soup

ingredients.label: 1 cup cooked lentils
ingredients.usda: Lentils, mature seeds, cooked, boiled, without salt

ingredients.label: 1¼ cups vegetable broth
ingredients.usda: Soup, vegetable broth, ready to serve

steps: Soften onion and carrot in the oil.
Add broth, tomatoes and lentils; simmer 15 min, stir in spinach.
recipes.why: Very high in fibre and low in energy density — soups and legumes help meals feel bigger.

recipes.name: Tofu, Broccoli & Brown Rice

ingredients.label: 180 g firm tofu
ingredients.usda: Tofu, raw, firm, prepared with calcium sulfate

ingredients.label: ¾ cup cooked brown rice
ingredients.usda: Rice, brown, long-grain, cooked (Includes foods for USDA's Food Distribution Program)

ingredients.label: 1 cup broccoli
ingredients.usda: Broccoli, cooked, boiled, drained, without salt

ingredients.label: 1 tbsp soy sauce
ingredients.usda: Soy sauce made from soy and wheat (shoyu)

steps: Press and cube tofu, pan-fry in the oil until golden.
Add broccoli, pepper and soy sauce; serve over rice.
recipes.why: Soy protein with whole grains and vegetables.

recipes.name: Black Bean & Sweet Potato Bowl

ingredients.label: ½ cup black beans
ingredients.usda: Beans, black turtle, mature seeds, canned

ingredients.label: 1 medium sweet potato
ingredients.usda: Sweet potato, cooked, baked in skin, flesh, without salt

ingredients.label: ⅓ cup corn
ingredients.usda: Corn, sweet, yellow, frozen, kernels cut off cob, boiled, drained, without salt

steps: Microwave the sweet potato 6–8 min and dice.
Warm beans and corn; assemble on romaine with salsa, avocado and lime.
recipes.why: Plant-based, gluten-free and high in fibre.

recipes.name: Lean Beef & Broccoli Rice Bowl

ingredients.label: 100 g 90% lean ground beef (cooked)
ingredients.usda: Beef, ground, 90% lean meat / 10% fat, crumbles, cooked, pan-browned

ingredients.label: ¾ cup cooked rice
ingredients.usda: Rice, white, long-grain, regular, enriched, cooked

ingredients.label: 1½ cups broccoli
ingredients.usda: Broccoli, cooked, boiled, drained, without salt

ingredients.label: 1 tbsp soy sauce
ingredients.usda: Soy sauce made from soy and wheat (shoyu)

steps: Brown beef with garlic; add broccoli and soy sauce for 3 min.
Serve over rice.
recipes.why: Lean red meat for protein and iron, balanced with a big portion of vegetables.

recipes.name: Chicken Fajita Rice Bowl

ingredients.label: 130 g cooked chicken breast
ingredients.usda: Chicken, broilers or fryers, breast, meat only, cooked, roasted

ingredients.label: ⅔ cup cooked rice
ingredients.usda: Rice, white, long-grain, regular, enriched, cooked

steps: Sear sliced pepper and onion in the oil with fajita spices.
Add sliced chicken; serve over rice and romaine with salsa and lime.
recipes.why: Gluten-free and high in protein; double the batch for lunches.

recipes.name: Tuna & White Bean Salad

ingredients.label: 1 can tuna (drained)
ingredients.usda: Fish, tuna, light, canned in water, without salt, drained solids

ingredients.label: 8 cherry tomatoes
ingredients.usda: Tomatoes, red, ripe, raw, year round average

steps: Toss everything together; season with pepper and oregano.
recipes.why: Pantry protein plus legumes and olive oil — Mediterranean and budget-friendly.

recipes.name: Lemon Cod, Zucchini & Couscous

ingredients.label: 150 g cod fillet
ingredients.usda: Fish, cod, Atlantic, cooked, dry heat

ingredients.label: 1 small zucchini
ingredients.usda: Squash, summer, zucchini, includes skin, raw

ingredients.label: 8 cherry tomatoes
ingredients.usda: Tomatoes, red, ripe, raw, year round average

steps: Roast zucchini and tomatoes 15 min with half the oil.
Bake cod 10–12 min with lemon and the rest of the oil; serve on couscous.
recipes.why: White fish is one of the leanest proteins available.

recipes.name: Chicken Avocado Salad

ingredients.label: 130 g cooked chicken breast
ingredients.usda: Chicken, broilers or fryers, breast, meat only, cooked, roasted

ingredients.label: 8 cherry tomatoes
ingredients.usda: Tomatoes, red, ripe, raw, year round average

steps: Slice chicken and avocado over the greens and vegetables; dress with oil and lemon.
recipes.why: Lower-carb: protein, healthy fats and vegetables.

recipes.name: Zucchini & Feta Frittata

ingredients.label: ½ zucchini
ingredients.usda: Squash, summer, zucchini, includes skin, raw

steps: Sauté vegetables in an oven-safe pan, pour over the whisked eggs and whites, add feta.
Bake 12–15 min at 190 °C / 375 °F. Serve with salad.
recipes.why: Vegetarian, gluten-free and lower in carbohydrate.

recipes.name: Turkey Meatballs & Whole-Wheat Pasta

ingredients.label: 110 g lean turkey, rolled into meatballs
ingredients.usda: Turkey, ground, 93% lean, 7% fat, pan-broiled crumbles

ingredients.label: 1¼ cups cooked whole-wheat pasta
ingredients.usda: Pasta, whole-wheat, cooked (Includes foods for USDA's Food Distribution Program)

steps: Bake meatballs 15 min at 200 °C / 400 °F.
Simmer in marinara with spinach; serve over pasta with parmesan.
recipes.why: A comfort meal kept lean, with whole-grain pasta for fibre.

recipes.name: Tempeh Tahini Bulgur Bowl

ingredients.label: 2 tsp tahini
ingredients.usda: Seeds, sesame butter, tahini, from roasted and toasted kernels (most common type)

steps: Pan-fry sliced tempeh until golden.
Massage kale with lemon; assemble with bulgur and carrot, drizzle tahini.
recipes.why: Fermented soy protein plus whole-grain bulgur.

recipes.name: Hummus & Chickpea Pita

ingredients.label: ½ cup chickpeas
ingredients.usda: Chickpeas (garbanzo beans, bengal gram), mature seeds, canned, drained solids

ingredients.label: 6 cherry tomatoes
ingredients.usda: Tomatoes, red, ripe, raw, year round average

steps: Spread hummus inside the pita, fill with chickpeas and vegetables.
recipes.why: Legumes and whole grains — a quick plant-based lunch.

recipes.name: Shrimp Marinara Zoodles

ingredients.label: 2 zucchini, spiralized
ingredients.usda: Squash, summer, zucchini, includes skin, raw

steps: Sauté garlic in the oil, add zucchini noodles for 2–3 min.
Add marinara and shrimp until hot; top with parmesan.
recipes.why: Swapping pasta for zucchini cuts calories and carbohydrate while keeping the volume.

recipes.name: Beef Burrito Bowl with Cauliflower Rice

ingredients.label: 110 g 90% lean ground beef (cooked)
ingredients.usda: Beef, ground, 90% lean meat / 10% fat, crumbles, cooked, pan-browned

steps: Brown beef with onion, pepper and taco spices.
Stir-fry cauliflower rice 5 min in the oil; top with beef and salsa.
recipes.why: A lower-carb take on a burrito bowl.

recipes.name: Salmon, Quinoa & Asparagus

ingredients.label: 110 g salmon fillet
ingredients.usda: Fish, salmon, Atlantic, farmed, cooked, dry heat

steps: Roast salmon and asparagus 12 min at 200 °C / 400 °F with the oil.
Serve on quinoa with lemon.
recipes.why: Gluten-free, with omega-3 fats from salmon.

recipes.name: Lentil Mushroom Bolognese

ingredients.label: ¾ cup cooked lentils
ingredients.usda: Lentils, mature seeds, cooked, boiled, without salt

ingredients.label: 1 cup cooked whole-wheat pasta
ingredients.usda: Pasta, whole-wheat, cooked (Includes foods for USDA's Food Distribution Program)

steps: Brown mushrooms in the oil, add lentils and marinara; simmer 10 min.
Serve over pasta.
recipes.why: Lentils replace minced meat: more fibre, less fat, lower cost.

recipes.name: Black Bean Corn Tacos

ingredients.label: ½ cup black beans
ingredients.usda: Beans, black turtle, mature seeds, canned

steps: Warm the tortillas and beans; fill with cabbage, salsa, avocado and lime.
recipes.why: Gluten-free (corn tortillas) and plant-based.

recipes.name: Chicken & Veg Traybake

ingredients.label: 130 g chicken breast
ingredients.usda: Chicken, broilers or fryers, breast, meat only, cooked, roasted

ingredients.label: 1 medium potato
ingredients.usda: Potatoes, Russet, flesh and skin, baked

ingredients.label: 1 cup broccoli
ingredients.usda: Broccoli, cooked, boiled, drained, without salt

steps: Toss potato and carrot chunks in the oil, roast 15 min at 220 °C / 425 °F.
Add chicken and broccoli, roast 18–20 min more.
recipes.why: One tray, simple ingredients, easy to batch for the week.

recipes.name: Seitan Pepper Stir-Fry

ingredients.label: 50 g vital wheat gluten (made into seitan)
¼ cup vegetable broth
ingredients.usda: Soup, vegetable broth, ready to serve

ingredients.label: 1 tbsp soy sauce
ingredients.usda: Soy sauce made from soy and wheat (shoyu)

ingredients.label: 1 cup broccoli
ingredients.usda: Broccoli, cooked, boiled, drained, without salt

ingredients.label: ⅔ cup cooked rice
ingredients.usda: Rice, white, long-grain, regular, enriched, cooked

steps: Knead vital wheat gluten with broth and half the soy sauce; simmer the pieces in salted water 15 min (or buy ready seitan).
Stir-fry with the vegetables and the rest of the soy sauce; serve over rice.
recipes.why: Seitan is wheat protein — one of the most protein-dense vegan foods (not for gluten-free diets).

recipes.name: Lentil Shakshuka

ingredients.label: ½ cup cooked lentils
ingredients.usda: Lentils, mature seeds, cooked, boiled, without salt

steps: Soften onion and pepper in the oil; add tomatoes, lentils, cumin and paprika and simmer 8 min.
Make wells, add eggs and whites, cover and cook 6–8 min.
recipes.why: Eggs plus lentils: protein and fibre without dairy or gluten.

recipes.name: Apple & Peanut Butter

ingredients.label: 1 medium apple
ingredients.usda: Apples, raw, with skin (Includes foods for USDA's Food Distribution Program)

ingredients.label: 1 tbsp peanut butter
ingredients.usda: Peanut butter, smooth style, without salt

steps: Slice the apple and dip.
recipes.why: Fibre plus a little fat and protein.

recipes.name: Hummus & Crunchy Veg
steps: Cut vegetables into sticks and dip.
recipes.why: High-volume, low-energy-density snack.

recipes.name: Salted Edamame
steps: Microwave frozen edamame 3–4 min, salt lightly.
recipes.why: About 18 g plant protein per cup.

recipes.name: Hard-Boiled Eggs & Orange
steps: Boil a batch on Sunday; peel and go.
recipes.why: Portable protein and fruit.

recipes.name: Greek Yogurt Cup

ingredients.label: 1 container nonfat Greek yogurt
ingredients.usda: Yogurt, Greek, plain, nonfat (Includes foods for USDA's Food Distribution Program)

ingredients.label: ½ cup berries
ingredients.usda: Blueberries, frozen, unsweetened (Includes foods for USDA's Food Distribution Program)

steps: Top yogurt with berries and honey.
recipes.why: ~18 g protein for under 150 kcal.

recipes.name: Popcorn & Pumpkin Seeds

ingredients.label: 1 tbsp pumpkin seeds
ingredients.usda: Seeds, pumpkin and squash seed kernels, dried

steps: Air-pop the corn, toss with seeds and a pinch of salt.
recipes.why: Whole-grain, high-volume and free of the common allergens.

recipes.name: Mozzarella Stick & Grapes

ingredients.label: ¾ cup grapes
ingredients.usda: Grapes, red or green (European type, such as Thompson seedless), raw

steps: Pack together.
recipes.why: Protein plus fruit, no prep.

recipes.name: Whey Protein Shake
steps: Shake or blend with ice.
recipes.why: A convenient 25 g protein top-up when meals fall short.

recipes.name: Crispy Roasted Chickpeas

ingredients.label: ½ cup chickpeas
ingredients.usda: Chickpeas (garbanzo beans, bengal gram), mature seeds, canned, drained solids

ingredients.label: pinch of curry powder or paprika

steps: Pat dry, toss with oil and spice, roast 25 min at 200 °C / 400 °F.
recipes.why: Crunchy legume snack with fibre and plant protein.
